apps.versionDescription: v1.5.23 — Tala Studio fits the screen again: the chip rows (tala, jati, chapu) wrap inside their cards instead of stretching the page past both edges. Also carries v1.5.22 (scrolling no longer freezes the playhead/time) and v1.5.21 (waveform hold, multiline notes).
apps.localizedDescription: RagaMentor native: LoopLab — slow down songs, keep pitch, loop sections. Built by GitHub Actions + fastlane on every push to main.
